findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT logs list risky hostname staging.copperline.example with pattern 'staging', first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15; risky_hostnames_count 1, unique_hostnames 12.

findings.deal_impact: A publicly logged staging system may expose non-production data or weaker controls and expand attack surface; validate its access controls and need before close, with limited expected deal impact if isolated or decommissioned.

remediation.summary: Confirm staging host is required, restrict to VPN/allowlist or decommission, and ensure no production data or credentials are present.

items.action: Confirm staging host is required, restrict to VPN/allowlist or decommission, and ensure no production data or credentials are present.

deal_recommendations.text: Require completion after close of the staging-host restriction or decommissioning in the Days 61–100 window at $7K–$35K, consistent with the Proceed signal [F-001].
Make no price adjustment, as total remediation of $7K–$35K is immaterial relative to the 10M-50M revenue band, with the sole item scheduled for Days 61–100 and the Proceed signal unchanged [F-001].

narrative.executive_summary:
Bottom line: Proceed with Copperline. Copperline scores 98.4 with an A rating and no caps applied, based on one finding and low confidence.

Key risks: A publicly logged staging hostname may expose non-production data or weaker controls and expand attack surface [F-001]. Its access controls and need require validation, though deal impact should be limited if it is isolated or decommissioned [F-001]. Production data or credentials on the host would raise exposure beyond a routine non-production issue [F-001].

Management credibility: No contradictions were identified: 0 contradictions, 0 contradicted claims, 0 unsupported claims, and 0 supported claims across 1 finding [F-001]. No management interview or SOC 2 report was provided, so credibility is untested against representations [F-001].

Next steps: Confirm before close if the staging host is required, its access controls, and that no production data or credentials are present [F-001]. Schedule VPN/allowlist restriction or decommissioning for Days 61–100 at $7K–$35K under IT Ops [F-001].
key_questions_for_management: Confirm whether the staging host is required for ongoing operations and identify its business owner [F-001]?
Provide evidence of the staging host's current access controls, including any VPN or allowlist restrictions [F-001]?
Confirm whether any production data, production credentials, or shared secrets are present on the staging host [F-001]?
Provide a plan and timeline to restrict or decommission the staging host within Days 61–100 at the $7K–$35K cost estimate [F-001]?
Reconcile the publicly logged staging hostname against the complete inventory of public hostnames and confirm no other admin, legacy, or staging systems remain exposed [F-001]?
Confirm who will own remediation after close and provide the completion evidence that will be delivered to the board [F-001]?
